workflow: Direct dataset patch review, not cards. Independent semantic review only, not integration authorization.

source_read.finding: Abstract reports 61 proto-porcelain sherds from eight Deqing sites. Table 3.1 lists 12 excavated Nanshan sherds and a kiln wall in Shang; Appendix 3 tabulates glaze chemistry for four Nanshan sherds. The author reconstructs deliberate application and wood ash as most likely from composition, not direct observation. Pages 142–143 explicitly do not resolve washed versus potash-depleted firebox ash.

duplicate_extension.rationale: Base record describes Deqing ash glazing but records broad Shang China proto-porcelain archaeological evidence and Zhou prevalence, not a separate process event; a narrowly scoped manufacturing process is distinct in grain. It is not a claim of separate independent invention or mere regional adoption.

relation.context: Functional process for analysed Deqing wares; same-study interpretive inference, not historical transmission or strict universal prerequisite. Cross-event dates refer to related samples and a broad Shang archaeological event, not proof of manufacture at other locations.

independence: The thesis and Yin/Rehren/Zheng article represent overlapping research and do not constitute independent corroboration. No consequential transmission or priority claim approved.
